# `aitbc agent config-import`

Import agent configuration from a JSON file.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent config-import [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--file-path` | text | — | yes | Path to the file. |
| `--name` | text | — | no | Override agent name |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent config-import --file-path <file_path>
```
